title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot! — Episode6 The Photos From That Day

meta.Episode: Episode6 — The Photos From That Day
meta.Event Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: Several minutes later
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Okay, we still haven't tried...
Oh, we could try a low-angle shot.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi, I'd like to try a low-angle shot next. Can you try looking down at the camera for me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
This isn't bad, but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How'd that turn out, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, it looks great...
And you look cool and mature...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But because of how our second photo went, I think we're going to have to find a way to do better...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we may need to try something completely different...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, we could try for more charm like Airi and the others. Something that really catches people's attention.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Charm...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I've been trying to take eye-catching photos, but haven't really been thinking about the whole picture like they have...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, what if we tried using some props like them? But I don't have any good ideas from the top of my head...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Why don't we take a quick break?
Some ideas might come to us after we've had a chance to rest a little...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, good idea...
Thanks for the suggestion, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'm going to go get something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'll go with you.
Would you like anything, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay.
You two go without me.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But how do you achieve that sort of charm? I need to think of a way...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, I won't be able to beat Ena and the others at their own game.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Still, are we really going to be able to take something better by trying whatever comes to mind like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm supposed to be taking a break, but my mind wants to keep trying to think of something...
<Heya, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka! KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Sorry for dropping in so suddenly.
We came to visit since you said you'd be doing your shoot for that photo contest today!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<So, how are things going?
Is something bothering you by chance...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Actually, yes...
We've been able to take a couple of good photos, but we're having trouble getting back into the top ten...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to take something better, but I'm not really sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Something better...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <First, can you show us what you've already taken? We might be able to help you after we've had a chance to look!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sure...!
Any advice would be really helpful right now...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, here's what we've taken so far...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Wow! Toya looks so cool!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<What a beautiful shot!
I really like how the light's hitting him.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hmm... I honestly only have good things to say about this.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Me too!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But you want to take an even better one, right, Kohane?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Actually...
In your mind, what makes a photo “good”?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If you clarified that, then we might be able to figure out the solution to this problem!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: To me, a good photo is...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's really hard to put into words...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I try to copy the way other people frame things and use lighting, but that alone doesn't guarantee quality...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There are plenty of great photos out there that don't adhere to basic foundations.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, what is it that makes a photo “good”...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, Kohane! It wasn't meant to be such a hard question!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I'm sorry for not being able to find the right words...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's understandable. If someone asked me what makes a song “good”, I probably wouldn't be able to give a quick response either.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know...! Kohane, can you tell us about some of the times when you thought you took some really good pictures?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I...? Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think the photos I took of a show I saw at PXL are the first ones that I thought were really good...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <PXL? You mean that amusement park you really love?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was in junior high school and it was the first time I took a photo using the camera my dad gave me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The show was so magical. I got so excited that I couldn't help but take so many photos.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Most of them didn't turn out great. They were blurry and poorly framed...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I liked what I took...
I still feel that way even when I look at them now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh? Why's that?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I don't really know why...
But I get really excited whenever I look at them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Seeing the cast members' bright smiles and the sparkling lights puts me right back in that moment.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see... Then, it sounds like those photos mean quite a lot to you.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
They really do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I feel like all the pictures you take are beautiful and compelling... I always get excited whenever I look at them...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, you do...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes! I remember one of those flowers that looked so pretty in full bloom... Or that family of cats, which was so heartwarming...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's clear what you were feeling each time you went to capture a scene.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Which is why I really love your work, Kohane. I think all the pictures you take are good.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She understands what my photos are really about. That makes me so happy...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(So, all my photos...
I guess they're a record of what I felt after seeing those things...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which allows me to go back in time, relive them and even share them with others... Is that why I love photography so much?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, to me, a “good” photo is...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I think I know how to answer your question now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, really?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes... I want to leave a record of the things that really move my heart.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And take photos in a way that others can understand what I was feeling. That's my aim...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm not really sure if that's the best way to receive likes from others...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Who cares?
You should take the photos you want, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What he said! Because if you don't think what you took is good, then there's no way others will!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <However, based on that logic, Kohane, you'll need to take a picture of Toya that you personally like...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hmm... What does that entail?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, was that a lightbulb?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm.... What if we took one of him smiling?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Smiling?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. When we first formed our team, Aoyagi's facial expressions didn't really change much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But as we spent more time together, he slowly began to learn how to smile and laugh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which sort of felt like evidence that we'd become close enough that he's willing to open up to us. I remember how happy I was after realizing that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, if we can somehow recreate that heartwarming atmosphere, then I think everyone who sees it will really like it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yeah, that's a wonderful idea!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Then, for your last attempt, you'll be going for Toya's smile...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I genuinely believe that a photo of him smiling will end up being the best one we take today!
